content: Capacitor is purpose-built to wrap existing vanilla JS/HTML/CSS web apps into native iOS/Android shells with minimal code change, and is actively maintained (successor to deprecated Cordova, backward-compatible with most Cordova plugins). React Native and Flutter require rewriting the UI/logic in a new framework. Godot/Unity are for engine-authored games, not existing DOM+canvas web apps, and add a large learning curve mismatch for a solo first-timer with a proven vanilla-JS engine already built. For a DOM-heavy UI with a single canvas element (not a full canvas-rendered game engine), Capacitor is the closest-fit, lowest-risk path.
